mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_name, dw.complain_category_id, c.category_name, c.category_cd FROM t1000_department_work dw JOIN t1000_department d ON d.dept_id = dw.department_id LEFT JOIN t2000_complain_category c ON c.complain_category_id = dw.complain_category_id WHERE dw.complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}
